user.description:
A Plex server can be set up in Home Assistant in two different ways.

You can link your Plex account by logging in via plex.tv, which will automatically discover and connect your servers, or you can manually enter the server address and token.

on_deck.description: Returns unfinished movies and the next episodes to watch from the Continue Watching list, with the same info as the search service plus watch progress. The results have a signed poster link (thumb_url) that works in dashboard cards and stays valid for a year or until Home Assistant restarts, and the same link without a signature (thumb_path).

search.description: Looks up Plex media and returns info (title, type, guid, rating key, server ID, year, summary, ratings, genres, watch status, and more) for each match. Accepts the same criteria as play media, or a free-text query. The results have a signed poster link (thumb_url) that works in dashboard cards and stays valid for a year or until Home Assistant restarts, and the same link without a signature (thumb_path).
